'''Paksi FC''' (''Paks''; {{IPA|hu|ˈpɒkʃ}}) is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Paks]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/01f2-0e78c4a1aee2-fdace6a8b8ed-1000--introducing-five-europa-league-newcomers/|title=Introducing five Europa League newcomers|date=28 June 2011|publisher=UEFA}}</ref> Since its founding in 1952, it has played at either a county or national level. In 2006, it ascended to the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I]], the top division in Hungarian football, for the first time.  It plays its home games at [[Fehérvári úti Stadion]]. The team colors are green and white. In the [[2010-11 Nemzeti Bajnokság I|2010–11 Hungarian Division]], the team finished second and qualified for the [[2011–12 UEFA Europa League|Europa League 2011–12]] season. The club is known for its policy of signing only Hungarian players.<ref>{{cite web |last=Noonan |first=Ben |title=Locals Only: Soccer Clubs that Won't Sign Foreigners |url=https://urbanpitch.com/locals-only-soccer-clubs-that-wont-sign-foreigners/ |website=Urban Pitch |date=October 9, 2025 |access-date=17 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251114203218/https://urbanpitch.com/locals-only-soccer-clubs-that-wont-sign-foreigners/ |archive-date=14 November 2025 |url-status=live}}</ref>"}}
